I am Tanmay Chanda, a data scientist and R and Shiny developer. I build
production Shiny applications, and I maintain three R packages on CRAN.

## What I can help with

**Production Shiny apps.** I build modular Shiny apps with golem, for real
users. This includes data import and validation, interactive tables and
dashboards, Docker, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, deployment to Azure, and unit
and end-to-end tests.

**Shiny that people must trust.** Some apps are in regulated or audit-heavy
settings, where users must trust the numbers. I build audit trails, validation
rules, and reconciliation and de-duplication of data from many sources. I also
show users where a result came from.

**Shiny performance and UX.** I find slow reactives, add loading states, and
give users undo and redo.

**Bayesian marketing mix models and forecasts.** I build Bayesian MMM and
forecasts in R with brms. I have 3+ years of experience with media budgets
for large US clients.

**Workshops and talks.** I give hands-on sessions on production Shiny, on
testing Shiny apps, and on Shiny in regulated settings.

## My R packages

All three are on CRAN.

- **[rewind](https://tenmeh.github.io/rewind/)** - undo and redo for Shiny
  apps.
- **[bones](https://tenmeh.github.io/bones/)** - loading placeholders in the
  shape of the content.
- **[whence](https://tenmeh.github.io/whence/)** - shows where a number in
  your app came from.

There is more on [GitHub](https://github.com/tenmeh).

## How we can work together

I work part-time and remotely, on a project or hourly basis. I am in India
(IST). I can overlap with mornings or evenings in the UK and the US.
